mission_09: Outstanding! You have successfully demonstrated inverse transformation with both MinMaxScaler and StandardScaler. You learned how to save scaler objects after fitting, apply inverse_transform to recover original values, and verify accuracy using np.allclose(). This is a crucial skill for production ML pipelines. When your model makes predictions on scaled data, you must inverse-transform those predictions to interpret them in the original units. Always save your scaler objects alongside your model so you can apply the same transformations to new data and recover meaningful predictions.
